$comment: Local corrections to the GBIF backbone slice in plantGenera.ts (#23).
Data, not code: merged by genusVocabulary.ts at load, so editing this file
takes effect without regenerating the vocabulary or touching the parser.
Every entry carries a justification. #39 is about curating this file from
real scan outcomes — a name the user keeps clearing, or keeps typing in by
hand — rather than from guesswork. Nothing here is applied automatically:
a human edits this file deliberately, per CONTEXT.md's rule that Tag Scan

additions.why: A real, widely sold garden genus (A. archangelica, A. gigas) that sits in the backbone as taxonomicStatus=DOUBTFUL under Apiaceae, so the ACCEPTED/SYNONYM filter drops it. The clearest case that no single status filter is correct.

exclusions.why: A doubtful Combretaceae genus that collides with ordinary marketing copy. Already absent while DOUBTFUL is filtered out, so this entry is belt-and-braces: it keeps the exclusion recorded if the status filter is ever loosened, and documents why the filter is drawn where it is.
